events.text: British prime minister Andy Burnham says that the United Kingdom will offer Saudi Arabia aerial refueling in its ongoing conflict with the Houthis.
A attack on a gold mining market in Sudan's North Kordofan state by Rapid Support Forces kills five citizens, including a goldsmith worker.

The Red Sea International Film Festival in Saudi Arabia is postponed to 2027 due to the ongoing conflict with the Houthis.
Two pilots are killed in a helicopter crash while fighting a wildfire in Yosemite National Park, California, United States.

An explosion injures three South Korean military officers during an operation inside the Demilitarized Zone, south of the military demarcation line. The Joint Chiefs of Staff says the cause remains unknown.
